purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century embryology petrography and geological-survey slide collections recovered by deep search.
guards: Do not convert mixed nineteenth/twentieth-century collection totals into nineteenth-century slide counts.
Keep microscope slides separate from lantern slides glass negatives and other visual media in archival fonds.
Preserve label-damage recataloguing transfer and rehousing as events rather than silently replacing earlier metadata states.

adapters.target: official collection page MCZbase and scanned original card catalogue
adapters.promotion_rule: Use series/item and card-catalogue dates to isolate pre-1900 embryos; preserve 1992 split transfer and current cabinet replacement separately.
